name: Visitor enquiry persists
description: Ensure a fully completed enquiry is accepted only after durable storage.
steps: Enter name, valid email, organization and message
expected: Receipt appears after the backend accepts and saves the enquiry.

name: Diagnostic is a useful ungated calculation
description: Check calculator arithmetic and no-email first result.
steps: Check the result and click discuss these results
expected: 60 leads without recorded contact and a 70% contact rate are shown, without an email gate, and enquiry context is populated.

name: Mobile invalid input
description: Check small-screen functionality and truthful error handling.
expected: Invalid figures are rejected and missing contact information is not submitted.

name: Ethical and accessible proof
description: Confirm source-specific credibility and appropriate safeguards.
expected: Relevant leader, brand and services are present, results are not guaranteed, and engagement expectations are explicit.
